# The construct that caused ISS-0256, kept verbatim as the detector's subject.
#
# Not a .py file: the scan walks *.py, and a deliberate offender inside the
# corpus it polices would fail the very check it exists to exercise.
#
# A backslash inside an f-string EXPRESSION — here inside a nested f-string's
# literal text, which is where the obvious detector misses it. Legal from
# Python 3.12 (PEP 701); a SyntaxError on 3.11, which this project supports.
refs = ["TST-0001", "TST-0002"]
line = f"covers: [{', '.join(f'\"[[{r}]]\"' for r in refs)}]"
